sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/260552 (facility description, fee description, notices, rules, rate seasons, campsite catalog)

values.note: Closed at noon August 10, 2026 through the end of the 2026 summer season for a sewer system rehabilitation project. NPS lists the summer 2027 opening as 'TBD: check back in mid-November'; recreation.gov has a 2027 season (May 27 - Oct 3).

status.source: recreation.gov fee description ('The campground will close for the season at noon on August 10, 2026, and remain closed through the end of the 2026 summer season, for a sewer system rehabilitation project') + 2027 Peak Season 2027-05-27 to 2027-10-03 + NPS camping page ('Campground Dates for Summer 2027 ... Timber Creek Campground TBD: Check back in mid-November'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Total length limit 30 ft (vehicle + hitch + trailer); larger rigs may not enter. Recreation.gov catalogs 59 drive-in sites and 21 walk-to tent sites; the drive-in sites run 14-30 ft and 37 of them take a 23-ft rig; 9 pull-throughs. Some sites hold only one vehicle.

sites.source: NPS camping page ('Timber Creek Campground: 30 feet') + recreation.gov ('Vehicles larger than 30-feet are not permitted in Timber Creek campground'; 'Maximum Vehicle + Trailer Length = Vehicle + Trailer + Hitch = 30 ft') + campsite catalog 260552 (59 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 21 WALK TO; lengths; 9 Pull-through), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: recreation.gov ('During the summer season, potable water and restroom facilities are available ... A freshwater fill and dump station for trailers and RVs is available in the campground'; 'No Hookups ... No Shower or Laundry'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Summer only; closed in the winter camping season. Recreation.gov's 2027 season is May 27 - Oct 3 (2026 was May 21/22 - Oct 4 before the early closure).

season.source: recreation.gov ('Timber Creek Campground is closed during the winter camping season'; 2027 Peak Season 05-27 to 10-03; 2026 Peak Seasons 05-21 to 10-04), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation only (recreation.gov, its app, or 877-444-6777); no same-day sales and no booking at the campground. Some sites open 6 months ahead on a rolling window, others 2 weeks or 1 week ahead. The reservation includes a timed-entry permit (not Bear Lake Road); the park entrance fee is separate. 7 nights total park-wide May 1 - Oct 15. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: NPS camping page ('reservations are required'; 'There are no same day sales available at RMNP's campgrounds'; 'From May 1 through October 15, you can camp in the park 7 nights total parkwide') + recreation.gov ('All campsites are available by reservation only'; 'A number of campsites are available to be reserved up to 6-months in advance on a rolling window. Some campsites are available to be reserved 2-weeks prior ... 1-week prior'; rule maxStay 7 nights each year), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $35 a night; half with an Interagency Senior or Access pass. Park entrance fee separate.

fees.source: recreation.gov fee description ('$35.00 for standard nonelectric sites') + 2027 rates (StandardNonelectric/RVNonelectric $35) + NPS ('Standard Non-Electric Campsites $35 per night'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: NPS camping page ('America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Pass holders get a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-27

note: Rocky Mountain NP's only west-side campground, along the Colorado River 8 mi north of the Grand Lake Entrance on Trail Ridge Road at ~8,900 ft. Generators 7:30-10 a.m. and 4-8:30 p.m.; food in the lockers. --Claude
